description: Source code for a Git-related patch management module, handling diff parsing, hunks, and interactive patch application.

classes.name: struct patch_mode
classes.description: Defines different patch application modes with commands and prompts.

classes.name: struct hunk_header
classes.description: Hunk header information including offsets and line ranges.

classes.name: struct hunk
classes.description: Represents a diff hunk with start/end positions and usage flags.

classes.name: struct add_p_state
classes.description: State structure for managing patch application, including parsed diff data and user interaction.

methods.name: add_p_state_clear
methods.description: Resets and frees resources in add_p_state.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Prints formatted error message with color.

methods.name: setup_child_process
methods.description: Configures a child process with environment variables and arguments.

methods.name: parse_range
methods.description: Parses a range string into offset and count.

methods.name: parse_hunk_header
methods.description: Parses a diff hunk header from diff output.

methods.name: is_octal
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only octal digits.

methods.name: complete_file
methods.description: Marks a file diff as complete based on diff markers.

methods.name: normalize_marker
methods.description: Normalizes diff line markers to space or original character.

methods.name: parse_diff
methods.description: Parses diff output into internal data structures.

methods.name: find_next_line
methods.description: Finds the position of the next line in a buffer.

methods.name: render_hunk
methods.description: Renders a diff hunk into output buffer.

methods.name: render_diff_header
methods.description: Renders the diff header, possibly skipping mode change hunks.

methods.name: merge_hunks
methods.description: Merges overlapping or adjacent hunks into a single hunk.

methods.name: reassemble_patch
methods.description: Reconstructs the patch text from diff hunks.

methods.name: split_hunk
methods.description: Splits a large hunk into smaller hunks at context boundaries.

methods.name: recolor_hunk
methods.description: Applies color highlighting to a diff hunk.

methods.name: edit_hunk_manually
methods.description: Allows manual editing of a diff hunk via editor.

methods.name: recount_edited_hunk
methods.description: Recounts line counts after manual hunk editing.

methods.name: run_apply_check
methods.description: Runs 'git apply --check' to verify patch applicability.

methods.name: read_single_character
methods.description: Reads a single character input from user.

methods.name: prompt_yesno
methods.description: Prompts user for yes/no input.

methods.name: edit_hunk_loop
methods.description: Loop for manual editing of a diff hunk.

methods.name: apply_for_checkout
methods.description: Applies patch hunks to index and worktree for checkout mode.

methods.name: run_add_p
methods.description: Main function to run the add-patch process with various modes.
